results.name: Keystone
results.scope: x86-64 and ARM64: hand-encoded bytes, Capstone 5.0.9 disassembly and reassembly, base-relative branch versus literal RIP displacement, mnemonic error code; an unencodable ARM64 immediate reports errno 561 as "Unknown error"

results.name: esptool
results.scope: Offline image-info on a synthetic ESP32 image: header, segments, checksum and SHA-256; chip ID 9 is auto-detected as ESP32-S3; checksum/hash mismatches exit 0, a truncated segment exits 2, and --chip overrides the header chip ID without a warning while the checksum and hash stay valid

results.name: Z3
results.scope: Synthetic 16-bit serial check: blocking-clause enumeration finds exactly the three serials a brute-force search finds; an arithmetic >> in place of LShR finds only the one with the top bit clear; model_completion adds a default value to the model
